description: P2 Security & Trust hardening acceptance specifications. The executable local reference suite contains matching test coverage; provider/infrastructure live status remains separate.

cases.input: A sensitive identity operation has no trusted provider-specific MFA profile.
cases.expected: Deny the operation; a generic caller boolean must not satisfy step-up MFA.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: MFA auth_time is older than the configured freshness threshold.
cases.expected: Reject the stale attestation and require re-authentication.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: A signed Ed25519 capability is issued by one process and verified by an independent worker keyset.
cases.expected: Verify using public-key trust only; never share the issuer private signing key with workers.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: A delegated capability has a different audience or modified payload.
cases.expected: Reject signature or issuer/audience mismatch.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: A one-time delegated capability is submitted concurrently by separate workers.
cases.expected: Only one atomic consume succeeds; later or revoked attempts fail closed.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: A worker receives resource attributes needed for separation-of-duties checks.
cases.expected: Use only allowlisted signed resource attributes, not caller-supplied mutable metadata.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: A public Evidence, Orchestration or Change method has no unique policy registry mapping.
cases.expected: Coverage report identifies it and release gate returns HOLD.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: A caller invokes ChangeManager.propose_change without an internal request-bound authorizer.
cases.expected: Reject before persisting a proposal; do not rely only on adapter convention.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: OIDC discovery issuer, JWKS or algorithm does not match the server-pinned profile.
cases.expected: Conformance fails; do not follow token-controlled key URLs or accept weaker algorithms.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: An injected KMS client receives a DEK request for a tenant/object.
cases.expected: Bind tenant, object and purpose in provider encryption context; no raw key material is logged.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: SQLCipher library is unavailable and ordinary sqlite is present.
cases.expected: Fail closed; never open the database in plaintext mode.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: A tenant database key sidecar is created or rewrapped.
cases.expected: Persist only KMS-wrapped key, tenant-bound context and authenticated metadata.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: Two threads or processes initialize tenant DB encryption concurrently.
cases.expected: Inter-process coordination returns one consistent key state; no competing key sidecars.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: Structured audit/log records are sent to a storage backend.
cases.expected: Backend receives ciphertext envelope, not plaintext payload.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: An encrypted stream backup is truncated or has an altered authentication tag.
cases.expected: Reject integrity failure and abort transactional plaintext sink; publish no partial plaintext.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: An untrusted workload floods stdout/stderr beyond retained log caps.
cases.expected: Drain streams without unbounded memory; record bytes seen and truncation.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: A streaming OCI job has no valid, current, correctly scoped host quota receipt.
cases.expected: Do not spawn the workload.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: A durable access event must be anchored externally and reconciled.
cases.expected: Verify signed immutable receipt, sequence and hashes; hold protected operations if unavailable.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: An in-memory WORM test double is used in a production policy path.
cases.expected: Refuse to treat the test anchor as compliance-grade external immutability.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: Infrastructure provider returns a signed dedicated database receipt.
cases.expected: Verify tenant, IAM/network/KMS references, freshness, isolation mode and signature.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: Different Redis clients claim the same physical backend resource for different tenants.
cases.expected: Shared atomic binding registry rejects the second tenant.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: Shared infrastructure binding registry is unavailable.
cases.expected: Fail closed; do not fall back to a local process map only.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: Infrastructure attestation omits or stales a required control.
cases.expected: ProductionAdmissionGate returns HOLD for the exact release commit.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: Reviewer is same as author, scope incomplete or review signature invalid.
cases.expected: Production admission rejects the review.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.

cases.input: Infrastructure and human review are signed under separate trust keys and exact release hash.
cases.expected: Admission may pass only when every required evidence record is valid; this does not deploy infrastructure.
cases.must_not: Do not claim live provider or production deployment from a mocked adapter or local unit test.
